summary: Newton Golf Company, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Exchange Agreements with holders of existing convertible promissory notes. On July 6, 2026, the Company issued an aggregate of 24,092.61 shares of newly designated Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $1.00 per share in exchange for approximately $2.3 million of existing notes, inclusive of accrued interest. The exchange was conducted at 105% of outstanding principal. The Series A Preferred Stock is convertible into common stock at $1.00 per share. The Chairman participated on the same terms. The exchange relied on SEC Rule 3(a)(9) exemption. A Registration Rights Agreement was also entered into, requiring an initial registration statement within 30 days. This exchange restructures the company's debt-to-equity, reducing leverage. Watch for potential shareholder dilution and conversion mechanics.
